fasi.d: During this first stage we immerse ourselves in your needs and goals. We analyse the type of project and work closely with you to understand exactly what you want to achieve from your shopfront in Lugano.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to decorate a shopfront in Lugano?
faq.risposta: The price depends on the size of the window, the type of graphics and the materials chosen. A lettering or a logo costs relatively little, while a full window requires a dedicated project. We prepare a free, tailored quote in 24/48h.

faq.domanda: Which areas of Lugano do you cover?
faq.risposta: We cover the whole of Lugano, from the centre to neighbourhoods such as Paradiso, Cassarate, Viganello, Besso and Molino Nuovo, out to nearby municipalities like Massagno and Pregassona. We reach your business wherever it is, in the city and across the rest of Ticino.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to install the decoration?
faq.risposta: Installation usually takes four or five hours, but the time varies depending on the complexity of the design and the size of the window. We agree together on the best moment so as not to interfere with your shop's opening hours.

faq.domanda: Can you work in the centre despite the traffic restrictions?
faq.risposta: Yes. We know the old town's restrictions well and organise ourselves to work at the most convenient times, even when the shop is closed, so the application takes place without disrupting your business or the flow of customers.

faq.domanda: Is it possible to decorate only part of the window, such as the logo or some lettering?
faq.risposta: Of course. We can decorate just a portion of the window, such as the logo, the opening hours or a promotional message, for a targeted impact without covering the entire surface.

faq.domanda: What materials do you use and do they hold up in the sun?
faq.risposta: We use high-quality films that are resistant to UV rays and the elements. They withstand intense sun and glare off the lake with no problems, keeping colours vivid and sharp for years.

faq.domanda: Does the window need to be cleaned before application?
faq.risposta: Yes, the window must be clean and free of dust or residue to ensure a perfect bond. We take care of preparing the surface ourselves before applying the decoration.

faq.domanda: Do you also make privacy films for offices and studios?
faq.risposta: Yes. Besides decorative window graphics, we produce frosted and sandblasted-effect films, very popular with banks, professional practices and offices that want privacy while keeping light and elegance.
